name: Wearing Blow
description: Strike the edge of the target's guard with sand-laden knuckles so each blow shaves a little more away.

name: Shear Sand
description: Slice a sheet of sand across an incoming blow and shear its line a hand's width wide.

name: Fretting Step
description: Step on a fine fret of grit that carries the body a pace past the guard's reach.

name: Guard Reader
description: Let sand settle on a qi guard and read its thin places from where the grains cling.

name: Erosion Palm
description: Press a palm that wears at a shield's edge until the qi guard thins and begins to give.

name: Fretting Grip
description: Rub a grip of grit around the target's wrist and wear at it until the hand loosens.

name: Scouring Skin
description: Wrap the body in a skin of sand that wears at every weapon striking it.

name: Shield Eater
description: Pour a current of sand into a qi shield and chew its structure from inside until it collapses.

name: Hollowing Sand
description: Drive a narrow lance of sand through the thinned guard to the soft body beneath it.

name: Smother Fist
description: Press a palm wreathed in thick dust over the target's mouth and nose as it strikes.

name: Dust Curtain
description: Drop a curtain of heavy dust before the body so strikes lose their line inside it.

name: Dust Dive
description: Dive low beneath a rolling bank of dust and come up behind the foe.

name: Dust Breath
description: Breathe the dust in the air and learn where living breath is moving around the user.

name: Choke Flick
description: Flick a hard pinch of dust into the open mouth of a target who is mid-shout.

name: Smothering Cloud
description: Hold a thick cloud over the target's head until their breath thins and their blows slow.

name: Dust Maw
description: Open a wide maw of dust over a cluster of foes and close it so each breath turns thick.

name: Airless Guard
description: Surround the body in a pocket of settled dust that no hot or sharp thing reaches cleanly.

name: Lung Filler
description: Fill the target's breath with fine dust until they gasp and lose strength in every limb.

name: Burial Veil
description: Settle a heavy veil of dust over a group so each person under it slows and cannot easily rise.

name: Grain Cast
description: Cast a single hard grain from the surrounding field into the target's cheekbone.

name: Grain Mantle
description: Pull grains from the field into a mantle that covers the back and shoulders.

name: Grain Glide
description: Glide across the ground on grains that part before the feet and close behind them.

name: Grain Sense
description: Let the field of grains touch every nearby body and report their weight and motion.

name: Grain Sweep
description: Sweep a flat arc of grains through the field to rake every foe within reach.

name: Grain Anchor
description: Anchor a foe's feet with a thick patch of settled grains until they strain to lift them.

name: Living Grains
description: Move the whole field of grains at will to strike hold and cover the user in the same breath.

name: Grain Lance
description: Gather the field into a single spearhead of grain and loose it through the target's guard.

name: Layered Grain
description: Strike with a palm that carries a flat layer of sediment pressed against the target's chest.

name: Settled Mail
description: Let layers of sediment settle over the torso until they bind into a close mail.

name: Silted Slide
description: Slide down a shallow slope of sediment laid at the feet and rise a pace beyond.

name: Layer Flick
description: Flick a thin slab of hardened sediment that spins into the target's wrist.

name: Bed Reader
description: Press a palm to settled sediment and read the layers of footfalls pressed into it.

name: Layered Hook
description: Swing a hooked blow with stacked sediment on the knuckles that lands as a hard layered thud.

name: Layered Burial
description: Lay slow layers of sediment up the target's legs until they stand sunk to the thigh.

name: Sediment Fall
description: Drop a wide sheet of heavy sediment from above onto every foe in a narrow ring.

name: Heavy Layers
description: Stack layers of weight onto the target's arms until each lift costs twice the effort.

name: Sediment Weight
description: Press the full weight of a sediment basin onto one foe until their stance buckles.

name: Sedimentary Crush
description: Stack layers of sediment on the target in one instant and compress them until guard and bone crack.

name: Pairing Sand
description: Strike with both palms in turn so the second drives the sand the first has already packed.

name: Twin Sand Mantle
description: Raise a mantle of sand on each flank so a blow from either side meets a guard.

name: Twin Slide
description: Slide on two parallel tracks of sand so the body travels fast and level.

name: Twin Mote
description: Set two small sand marks apart and read distance and motion between them.

name: Dual Wave
description: Send two waves of sand from opposite sides to crash together over the target's feet.

name: Sand Twinning
description: Close two cords of packed sand around the target's ankles and pull them toward each other.

name: Matched Guard
description: Meet a strike with one palm of sand while the other turns it aside in the same motion.

name: Twin Crescents
description: Sweep two crescents of sand from opposite sides so they meet on the target and grind.

name: Paired Burial
description: Lay two great drifts of sand against the target from either side until both close over the legs.

name: Dust Stoop
description: Drop the palm from above like a hawk's stoop with a trail of dust behind the wrist.

name: Sandhawk Shroud
description: Spread arms wide under a shroud of dust shaped like folded wings.

name: Dust Skim
description: Drop from a half leap into a long low skid that carries the body ahead.

name: Dust Hawk
description: Raise a thin column of dust and read from its sway what stirs around the user.

name: Sandtalon Flick
description: Flick three hooked grains from the fingers that rake across the target's brow.

name: Sand Pinion
description: Beat aside a strike with a feathered sweep of sand along the forearm.

name: Falling Talons
description: Bring clawed hands down in a fall of sand that rakes shoulder and chest together.

name: Dust Pinions
description: Beat great wings of dust around the target so sight and balance both swim.

name: Rising Plume
description: Throw up a plume of dust beneath the foe's strike to knock the arm off line.

name: Wing Cut
description: Slash the edge of the hand through a sheet of sand shaped like a wing.

name: Great Stoop
description: Drop from height trailing a column of dust and land with the whole fall behind one blow.

name: Talon Rake
description: Rake a wide set of sand talons across a group so each foe is cut and driven down.

name: Worn Grain
description: Strike with a hand rough with wind-worn grain that scours as it lands.

name: Sand Oath
description: Stand sworn to the spot with sand banked at the heels and arms so no push shifts the stance.

name: Weathered Step
description: Step along a lane of weathered sand that ends exactly where the user means to land.

name: Grain Compass
description: Hold a grain on the palm and read the direction of every living thing from how it leans.

name: Sworn Flick
description: Flick a grain along the sworn line so it hits whatever crosses that line.

name: Wind-Worn Palm
description: Press a palm worn smooth by wind-sand that saps the strength from the limb it touches.

name: Sandbound Pin
description: Pin the target along a held line with sand drawn tight across their stance.

name: Wearing Oath
description: Swear a layer of rough sand around the body that wears at whatever breaks the oath.

name: Oath of Grains
description: Swear a ring of grains that strikes every foe crossing the line and keeps scouring until released.

name: Stripping Sand
description: Strip a foe's outer qi layer with a lance of rough sand and reach the body under it.

name: Plateau Palm
description: Strike flat and wide so a spread of sand leaps from the palm across the target.

name: Unwalled Shroud
description: Hold an open shroud of sand that gives way to any push and gathers again behind it.

name: Open Glide
description: Glide across open ground on a sheet of sand spread flat before the feet.

name: Sheet Sense
description: Spread a thin sheet of sand wide and feel every footfall that lands upon it.

name: Edge Sweep
description: Sweep a low arc of sand that carries away the footing of every foe in front.

name: Plateau Press
description: Press down on a foe with a wide flat weight of sand that grows heavier each breath.

name: Boundless Grain
description: Pour sand outward with no edge to the pour so it fills the ground and scours all upon it.

name: Spreading Burial
description: Let a tide of sand spread across the field and climb the legs of everyone standing in it.

name: Bearing Sandpalm
description: Strike along a bearing marked in the sand so the blow lands exactly where the line ends.

name: Moving Guard
description: Keep a guard of sand that shifts to meet each new angle of attack.

name: Sand Bearing
description: Step along the bearing as the sand shifts and reach the mark before the foe does.

name: Shift Reader
description: Read the slow shift of the sand underfoot and learn where weight is moving.

name: Grain Needles
description: Spray a stream of needle-fine grains along the bearing at the target's eyes and throat.

name: Shifting Hold
description: Let the sand shift round the target's feet until it locks them to the line.

name: Rolling Bearing
description: Roll a wave of sand down the bearing and strike behind it as the foe lurches.

name: Restless Sand
description: Stir the sand into restless motion so no foe can hold a steady stance.

name: Sweeping Bearing
description: Swing the bearing in a great arc so a band of sand sweeps every foe along it.

name: Sand Fastener
description: Fasten the foe to the line with sand that sets as the shifting ground stills around them.
